description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'GatewayInternalErrorException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project to signal an internal server error originating from the API Gateway. It includes factory methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and contains a nested builder class for constructing the exception.

classes.name: GatewayInternalErrorException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing a specific internal server error in the API Gateway with associated factory methods and a builder.

classes.name: GatewayInternalErrorException.Builder
classes.description: A nested static builder class implementing a fluent API to construct instances of GatewayInternalErrorException, marked as not thread-safe.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new mutable builder for GatewayInternalErrorException instances.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a provided message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated headers.
